chunks: My scholars narrated to me from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Dawud al-Sarmi, from Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him say: Whoever visits the grave of my father, for him is Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Rida according to Imam al-Jawad?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Jawad (a.s.) affirming that visiting the grave of his father, Imam al-Rida (a.s.), in Tus guarantees Paradise, underscoring the high spiritual status of the Imams' resting places in Shia tradition. This narration emphasizes the tangible reward of *ziyarat* as an act of devotion that connects the believer directly to the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the theological importance of their physical presence in the world even after death.
